paseo-steps-viewer._note: Runs from the paseo-plugins dev clone (workspace node_modules at the repo root; Node strips types, no build). Reuses the plugin HTTP server tools and tmp index, so both sides share documents. Step-ledger tools: next_step, complete_step, amend_step, add_step, drop_step, step_status + save_steps/update_steps/list_steps/list_capabilities. Doc convention: '## Step N — Title [pending|active|done|blocked]' with '> result DD-MM-YYYY:' note blocks; pair with the stepwise skill.
